load_path_decomposition.load_path_read: The desired structural bracing credit is owned by cap/collar/bond/tube-wall details. Foam-only stiffness is explicitly not credited.

steps.description: Final closure spanload supplies vertical lift. The current kernel places lift on the main spar line; the local model applies it at main collar/rib web entry points as a conservative load-owner basis.
Span-axis aerodynamic torque is converted from kernel My into a main/rear vertical force couple at each collar: F=M/d.
Balsa/cap faces transfer rib web shear between skin, main collar, rear collar, and cap strip. EPS is shape support only.
Adhesive and collar transfer shear/peel/bearing into main and rear spar tubes; tube walls must clear bearing, local crush, and ovalization.

boundary_conditions.application: At R066 and R070 spar cross-sections, constrain only rigid body modes through remote section nodes; carry axial/torsion/bending resultants from the global beam if available.
Tie or bonded contact from collar inner surface to spar tube outer surface; run a peel-sensitive variant if adhesive thickness data exists.
Bond rib cap/face strips to collar tabs and rib web; do not bond EPS core directly as a structural bracing member.
Include bay skin panel or equivalent pressure/handling load if the coupon plan is used to clear shape keeping.

method.engineering_boundary: These are screening nodal loads for the local model contract. Final FEM loads must be regenerated if the closure load owner or selected stiffness changes.
method.load_update_basis: Structural load ownership is preserved by scaling existing lift and pitch-torque distributions by AVL wing spanload ratios.

method.torque_to_couple_formula: F_couple_N = M_y_Nm / spar_separation_m; apply +F at main spar and -F at rear spar
